theme.name: Filmmaking & Animation
theme.audience: filmmakers, animators, motion designers, storyboard artists
theme.market_anchor: the animation industry (~$400B incl. film/TV) with >500K working animators

ideas.title: FrameChain Legacy
ideas.pitch: Securely mint unique storyboard sequences proving original authorship and evolution.
ideas.quantumRationale: Immutable minting ensures incontestable ownership and version history on IPFS.
ideas.som: $500M — digital storyboard NFT platforms for creators

ideas.title: AnimMint Vault
ideas.pitch: Create NFT-verified character animations to authenticate originality and usage rights.
ideas.quantumRationale: ERC-721 minting links unique animation CIDs with creator identity on-chain.
ideas.tam: $400B — animation market including film and TV

ideas.title: SceneStamp Auth
ideas.pitch: Mint entire scene compositions as NFTs to protect creative framing and direction.
ideas.quantumRationale: NFT provenance solidifies scene ownership and timestamp on Sepolia.
ideas.sam: $20B — scene design and virtual production solutions

ideas.title: MotionMark Ledger

ideas.quantumRationale: ERC-721 tokens create secure, transferable motion design ownership proofs.
ideas.tam: $400B — global animation and motion design sector
ideas.som: $100M — NFT catalogs of motion design assets

ideas.title: ColorProof Chain
